gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: The city is ___ (FAME) for its architecture.
gaps.explanation: 'Famous for' — 'infamous' means notorious (famous for bad things).

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.
